name: Michael Darmousseh
current_role: Co-founder, Extend (product-protection/warranty platform, San Francisco); listed variously as SVP Engineering / CTO
profile: Co-founder of Extend, the San Francisco post-purchase platform offering product protection, shipping protection and returns for merchants. He started the company in February 2019 with Woodrow Levin, Joe Moss and Rohan Shah; Extend raised a $260M SoftBank-led round in 2021 at a valuation of over $1B.
interesting_fact: Extend was co-founded in February 2019 and within ten months of its Series A closed a $40M Series B, signing merchants such as Peloton, iRobot and Harman/JBL.
notes: Low public profile; engineering-side co-founder. Exact current title unverified (sources say SVP Engineering, CTO or Distinguished Engineer). Best route likely via Extend (extend.com) or CEO Woodrow Levin. No published press email found.

name: Huang Yun
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Shenzhen Shunfeng Express Co. (SF Freight / 顺丰快运), per 36Kr company record (may be dated)
profile: Huang Yun (黄贇) is listed as chairman and legal representative of SF Freight (顺丰快运), the less-than-truckload and heavy-parcel freight arm of China's SF Holding group, incorporated in Shenzhen in October 2019. SF Freight raised a US$300M round in 2020 from CCP, CDH and Legend Capital, among others. Little else is publicly documented about him.
interesting_fact: SF Freight's company entity was set up on 9 Oct 2019 and raised a US$300M round in Feb 2020 from investors including CDH Investments and Legend Capital.
notes: Very low public profile; Chinese name appears as 黄贇 in the 36Kr registry entry. 'Founder' framing comes from Hurun; he is better described as SF Freight's chairman within SF Holding (founded by Wang Wei). Current role after ~2020 not verified. Route would be via SF Holding investor/press relations.

name: Ilan Atias
current_role: Co-founder and CTO, Melio (B2B payments; acquired by Xero in 2025) - current status post-acquisition unverified
profile: Israeli engineer who co-founded Melio in 2018 with Matan Bar and others, serving as CTO and running its Tel Aviv R&D centre. Melio, a bill-pay platform for US small businesses, was acquired by New Zealand's Xero for about $2.5B, completing in October 2025.
interesting_fact: When Melio hired an R&D chief in 2022, Atias said platform processing volume was 'surging to tens of billions of dollars annually'; Xero later bought Melio for about $2.5B.
notes: Search snippets suggest he may have left Melio after the Xero deal (unverified). Prior role reportedly VP R&D at maritime-AI firm Windward (aggregator sources only, not verified).
